rules.name: Stable Entity Identifier Consistency
rules.description: Every entity must have a deterministic identifier prefixed with country and domain code.

rules.name: Mandatory Provenance Reference
rules.description: Factual records must contain a valid HTTP(S) source URL, publisher, and an explicit evidence_class.

rules.name: Strict Punctuation Format Compliance
rules.description: No em dashes (unicode U+2014) may appear in any string, comment, or label.

rules.name: Honest Verification State Gate
rules.description: A record may only be marked VERIFIED if evidence_class is RETRIEVED_OFFICIAL and it carries the sha256 of a really retrieved artifact. Hand-written and synthetic records stay UNVERIFIED.

rules.name: Currency Code Conformance
rules.description: Monetary values must preserve original ISO 4217 currency (CNY or IDR); never convert implicitly.
